news.title: Who Controls Ukraine’s Starlink Access?
news.summary_en: A 100 mph speed limit on Starshield terminals hindered Ukraine’s efforts to intercept Russia’s jet-powered drones. The risk of losing access during an attack gives allies another reason to build their own networks instead of buying service from U.S. companies.

news.title: From Meters to Machine Learning: Building AI-Ready Utilities in India
news.summary_en: Can AI help improve India’s power distribution utilities? An original survey of utilities in Tamil Nadu and Odisha finds that strong digital infrastructure, interoperable data, and in-house capacity will determine whether AI can deliver results at scale.
